title: Best AI Model for Your Money — Free LLM Price & Value Tracker
excerpt: Find the AI model with the most intelligence per dollar — priced at the cheapest provider actually selling it, not the lab's list price. Updated daily.

Frequently asked questions

Which LLM API is the cheapest?+

It depends on your input/output mix, but small models are usually cheapest — right now the lowest blended rate we track is about $0.010 per 1M tokens. See the LLM prices today table for the full cheapest-first ranking.

How much do GPT, Claude and Gemini cost per 1M tokens?+

Each provider prices input and output tokens separately, and output is usually 3-5x more expensive. Open each model's page for its exact input, output and cached rates, or use the LLM API cost calculator to turn those rates into a per-request and monthly bill.

How often are the prices updated?+

Prices are re-checked daily against each provider's official pricing and the site is rebuilt automatically, so the numbers you see are current for today. This page's data was last verified 2 September 2026.

How do you measure how smart a model is?+

We show LMArena (arena.ai) Elo scores, a crowd-sourced leaderboard from millions of blind human head-to-head votes. It is the single, clearly attributed intelligence source we use; models with no Arena score simply show no score rather than a guess.

Are the open-weight model prices first-party?+

Where a lab publishes an official API price (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, and most Qwen/Kimi/GLM models) we use it. For open-weight models a lab doesn't sell directly, we show a clearly labeled representative host rate so the model can still be compared.

Do I need to sign up or install anything?+

No. Every calculator and table runs in your browser with no signup, and results update live as you type. You can copy a shareable link to any calculation or filtered view.
